_comment: EXAMPLE governance policy — this is a GENERIC placeholder, not any real organization's rules. Copy this file to 'enterprise_policy.local.json' (gitignored) and replace every value with YOUR organization's actual rules. The harness enforces and scores ONLY what you declare here; it never infers or invents rules.

rbac._comment: Permission scope. Which systems/actions the AI may NEVER touch autonomously, and which low-risk actions are pre-approved (guardrailed mode).

change_windows._comment: When changes are frozen. Fill in your real freeze periods (e.g. month-end close, blackout phases).

approval._comment: Who signs off, and whether break-glass emergency action is permitted for outages.

notification._comment: Escalation / communication rules. Declared here; enforcement is the next slice.
